announcements.title: Interested in Joining the Body of Christ at CPC?
announcements.description:
We consider the church an essential element of the gospel, so joining CPC as a member is a way to truly join the body of Christ, in all its blessings and with all its flaws! Before joining, you’ll meet one-on-one with a pastor and then discuss how you’ve come to know Christ with the Shepherd Leaders. Email admin@cpcnewhaven.org to begin the process.

Our next joining will take place on Sunday, November 15.

announcements.title: Thanksgiving Fellowship Meals
announcements.description:
Sign Up Here as Host or Guest

Staying local for Thanksgiving? Come celebrate with your brothers and sisters in Christ! As we’ve done in the past, we’re coordinating hosts & guests to have a Thanksgiving meal together on November 26. If you're interested, please email admin@cpcnewhaven.org or fill out the form.

announcements.title: Pastor Drop-in Office Hours
announcements.description:
Craig, Fridays 7:30–10:30am | Jerry, Wednesdays Noon–3:00pm | Other hours available upon request

Drop in for a casual time of discussion, Q&A, prayer, coffee, tea, really whatever you want to make it! If you have a more private or formal need, you’re always welcome to set up a separate time with Pastor Craig (craig.luekens@cpcnewhaven.org), or Pastor Jerry (jerry.ornelas@cpcnewhaven.org) but this is meant to be a space where anyone can drop in.

announcements.title: Life Groups and Discipleship Groups
announcements.description: Life Groups and Discipleship Groups are our way of doing “church in the small” where we meet throughout Greater New Haven to be engaged in prayer, teaching, fellowship and care. For information on which Life Group may be a good fit, email admin@cpcnewhaven.org.

announcements.description: If you’re interested in connecting more spontaneously with CPC folks, you’re welcome to join our WhatsApp Community "CPC New Haven".

announcements.title: Women's Discipleship Group
announcements.description: The Women's Discipleship group is starting a new book on October 5 - is this the right time for you to join?  We'll be going through the book Side by Side by Edward T Welch.  This is an opportunity to encourage and challenge one another as we seek to follow Christ by loving those around us!  We meet virtually on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of each month at 7:30pm. If interested, please reach out to Lisa Graham or Diane Miller.

announcements.title: Mom's Discipleship Group
announcements.description: Please join us! CPC Moms discipleship group will begin meeting monthly on 9/16/26 in the Fellowship Hall at 9:45am. Children are welcome to play near us while we meet. We will discuss selected podcasts from Ruth Chou Simons, a gifted writer of over 10 books, artist, mother of 6, podcaster, and founder of GraceLaced.  Future dates: 10/14, 11/11, no Dec, 1/13/27. Please inquire with any young mom, or Meg Bogue with questions.

announcements.title: College Bible Study
announcements.description: Come join us in the CPC Fellowship Hall as we kick off our fall College Bible Study! Over the next six weeks, we’ll dive into the first seven chapters of Romans and explore the “Blueprint” for faith. If the gospel is “the power of God for salvation,” what exactly does that power look like in our lives? Come join us as we open this great book together and discover what Romans has to say about the gospel, faith, and the way we live.

announcements.title: College Ice Cream Outing
announcements.description: Come join us at Elena’s on Orange for ice cream & fun! Take a break from the books, bring a friend, and enjoy some good conversation and fellowship. We’d love to see you there!

announcements.title: Young Adults Beach Hang
announcements.description: Hey young adults! Come hang with us at Woodmont Beach in Milford, CT beginning at 2:00 p.m. Bring a chair or blanket to sit on and a snack to share! This beach has a volleyball net, playground, and swimming access. If you need a ride, text Josh Sanders at 951-813-6521 or email him at joshuatsanders@yahoo.com. Hope to see you there!

announcements.title: Adult Class | "The Wonders of Communal Worship"
announcements.description: This class will be a great opportunity to discuss all that God promises to do through communal worship, and why we worship the way we do at CPC. We’ll study exciting theology, insight into how we’re created, principles for deciding worship styles, and more. All are welcome.

announcements.description: As we prepare for another year of Sunday School, we'd love for all parents of children participating in Sunday School (2 & 3 year olds through 12th grade) to join us for a brief meeting immediately following the morning worship service in the Sanctuary. announcements.title: CPC College Internship Program | Application deadline THIS Sunday, May 3rd
announcements.description: An opportunity for undergraduate students who desire to grow deeper in theology, godliness, and participation in ministry. Students will engage in theological training, personal formation, and missional opportunities in New Haven. The goal is to ground participants in sound doctrine, cultivate personal godliness, and, where applicable, help discern a call to ministry. The program offers two tracks: a Ministry Track for those exploring vocational ministry and a Formation Track for those seeking deeper theological and spiritual growth. Open to all undergraduate students. For more information or to apply, contact Pastor Jerry at jerry.ornelas@cpcnewhaven.org.

announcements.title: THIS SATURDAY! Young Adults’ Ozdust Ball | 6:30-10:00 PM | CPC Fellowship Hall
announcements.description:
We are hosting a ball to reach out to the young adult students and professionals inside our church and in the wider New Haven community. We also hope this will be a chance for those who have not yet come to church to experience our community in a fun way. Please invite friends who fall into this category! There will be food, music and dancing, and the theme is the land of Oz. 

Reach out to Josh Sanders, Marney Walker or Ellen Martin if you’d like to volunteer with making decorations or clean-up!
